title: Polydatin attenuates LPS-induced acute lung injury in rats via targeting HSP90AB1.
authors: Han, Liang; Shi, Ziye; Meng, Fancui; Han, Yanqi; Li, Xin; Zhang, Xian; Xu, Jun; Zhang, Tiejun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药虎杖苷靶向HSP90AB1蛋白抗急性肺损伤的炎症机制，核心是蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于核酸体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The root of Polygonum cuspidatum Sieb. et Zucc, referred to as Huzhang in traditional Chinese medicine, is widely employed in therapeutic formulations against inflammatory diseases. As its core bioactive constituent, polydatin (PD), exhibits anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. Despite these pharmacological properties, the molecular targets underpinning PD's anti-inflammatory actions in pulmonary disorders remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study aims to identify therapeutic targets and elucidate the molecular mechanisms of PD against acute lung injury (ALI). MATERIALS AND METHODS: In a rat model of ALI induced by LPS, PD was administered at doses of 10, 20, and 40 mg/kg for 7 consecutive days to evaluate therapeutic efficacy. Integrated approaches, including cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), thermal proteome profiling (TPP), mass spectrometry, site-directed mutagenesis, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, fluorescence-based thermal shift assay (FTS) and microscale thermophoresis (MST), were used to identify potential target and binding sites. Subsequently, RAW264.7 cell lines overexpressing the target protein were established to investigate its regulatory effects on inflammatory pathways. Cellular/tissue co-localization, western blotting, and immunohistochemistry (IHC) further revealed that PD targets HSP90AB1 and modulates the IL-17/MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway. RESULTS: It was demonstrated that PD significantly attenuates LPS-induced inflammatory responses both in vivo and in vitro. Subsequently, PD was confirmed to specifically target HSP90AB1 by binding to its Asp88 residue. Critically, mechanistic studies revealed that PD binding disrupts HSP90AB1-mediated stabilization of the client protein ACT1, thereby suppressing the IL-17/MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway. CONCLUSION: Polydatin confers protection against ALI in rat models by targeting HSP90AB1 and suppressing the IL-17/MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：虎杖（Polygonum cuspidatum Sieb. et Zucc.）的根，在传统中医中称为“虎杖”，广泛用于治疗炎症性疾病的方剂中。其核心生物活性成分虎杖苷（polydatin, PD）具有抗炎、抗氧化和免疫调节作用。尽管具有这些药理特性，但PD在肺部疾病中发挥抗炎作用的分子靶点仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在识别PD对抗急性肺损伤（acute lung injury, ALI）的治疗靶点，并阐明其分子机制。材料与方法：在LPS诱导的大鼠ALI模型中，以10、20和40 mg/kg的剂量连续7天给予PD，以评估其治疗效果。采用整合方法，包括细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay, CETSA）、热蛋白质组分析（thermal proteome profiling, TPP）、质谱分析、定点突变、分子对接、分子动力学模拟、基于荧光的热位移分析（fluorescence-based thermal shift assay, FTS）和微量热泳动（microscale thermophoresis, MST），以识别潜在靶点和结合位点。随后，建立过表达靶蛋白的RAW264.7细胞系，以研究其对炎症通路的调控作用。细胞/组织共定位、蛋白质印迹和免疫组织化学（immunohistochemistry, IHC）进一步揭示，PD靶向HSP90AB1并调节IL-17/MAPK/NF-kappaB通路。结果：研究表明，PD在体内和体外均显著减轻LPS诱导的炎症反应。随后，确认PD通过结合其Asp88残基特异性靶向HSP90AB1。关键的是，机制研究揭示，PD结合破坏了HSP90AB1介导的客户蛋白ACT1的稳定化，从而抑制IL-17/MAPK/NF-kappaB通路。结论：虎杖苷通过靶向HSP90AB1并抑制IL-17/MAPK/NF-kappaB通路，在大鼠模型中赋予对ALI的保护作用。
